subject: App Not Collecting Garmin Data
body:
Hello,
 
I am reaching out with regard to study #4055. It looks like the app is not collecting the Garmin data even though the participant is wearing the watch, it is synced with the Garmin app, and Avicenna has permission to connect with the Garmin app.
 
Is there any way you might be able to troubleshoot on your end?
 
Thanks,
Ximena

​​___

Ximena Giesemann, M.A. (she/her)

Doctoral Candidate | Positive Developmental Psychology

Well-Being & Developmental Methods Research Lab

Claremont Graduate University


I honor and respect boundaries around personal time, well-being, care-taking, and rest. If you receive this message while engaged in any of these things, please take that time for yourself and respond when you can.

subject: App Not Collecting Garmin Data
body:
Hi Ximena,
Thanks for sharing this with us and I'm sorry for any inconvenience this is causing.
Can you please share the following information:
- What's the participant ID?
- Do you have any other participants in this study? Is this issue widespread?
- How do you check for the Garmin data? Are you sure that you have set the filters correctly?

Best regards,
Amin

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/26073/5ef4c6628288b0b9
